films.title: You & Me
films.synopsis: A razor-edged romantic thriller where desire and danger share the same bed. Produced by Nisha Singh with story, screenplay, dialogues and direction by Shiva Kovelkar — cinematography by Kolli Prasad and music by Sri Venkat. Passion turns to suspicion, and love becomes the deadliest game of all.

films.title: Dakshina Kali
films.synopsis: A fierce mythological drama channelling the divine power of Goddess Kali. When darkness descends on a temple town, an ordinary family is drawn into a battle between devotion and evil — and the Goddess answers. A grand, faith-driven spectacle released simultaneously across three languages.

films.title: Prati Friendu Avasarama
films.synopsis: An intimate ensemble drama about love, family and the quiet question every heart asks — does it matter? Interlocking stories of ordinary people search for meaning and connection in modern Telugu life. A warm, character-driven festival favourite.

films.title: The Game of Chaduranga
films.synopsis: Every move is calculated. Every player has a secret. A taut Kannada crime thriller where ambition, betrayal and power play out like a deadly game of chess. Available in stunning 4K — a slick, twist-laden ride to the very last square.

films.title: Ika Nee Love
films.synopsis: A tender, music-laced Telugu romance about young love, distance and second chances. When two hearts drift apart, fate writes one more verse. Soulful, sincere and made for anyone who's ever believed in love that finds its way back.
